{"answers":[{"question_id":"Q012_not_true_family_specific_pair","answer":"No. In SCOPe 2.08, d1s9za_ is the Synthetic domain under Protein node 103785, Amyloidogenic design-1, and d1hqja_ is the Synthetic domain under Protein node 100906, Unnamed design-1. They are placed together in class k, Designed proteins; fold k.40 / SUNID 100903, Designed trimeric coiled-coil; superfamily k.40.1 / SUNID 100904, Designed trimeric coiled-coil; and family k.40.1.1 / SUNID 100905, Designed trimeric coiled-coil. That shared k.40.1.1 family assignment should not be read as an evolutionary homology assertion for this pair, because the family node itself is annotated “not a true family”.
